title: Heredity and the Aetiology of the Neuroses
version_note: Monroe Meyer's 1924 English translation of Freud's French article first published in Revue Neurologique 4 (1896), pp. 161-169. The complete historical manifestation and its bibliographic record in the Freud Edition were read on 2026-07-27; the edition identifies the 1896 publication date and the English text's editorial note identifies this occurrence as Freud's first use of the term for his technique. No copy is stored in this repository.
